import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import re

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
      'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}

path = 'budget.xlsx'
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("FILES IN ARCHIVE:")
    for n in names:
        print(" ", n)

    # shared strings
    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('m:si', NS):
            text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
            shared.append(text)

    # workbook sheet list
    wbroot = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    sheets = wbroot.find('m:sheets', NS)
    sheet_list = []
    for s in sheets.findall('m:sheet', NS):
        sheet_list.append((s.get('name'), s.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id')))

    # sheet rels
    relroot = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    rels = {}
    for rel in relroot:
        rels[rel.get('Id')] = rel.get('Target')

    print("\nSHEETS:")
    for name, rid in sheet_list:
        target = rels[rid]
        if not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target = 'xl/' + target
        print(f"  {name} -> {target}")

    print("\nCELL DATA:")
    for name, rid in sheet_list:
        target = rels[rid]
        if not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target = 'xl/' + target
        sroot = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        print(f"=== Sheet: {name} ===")
        for row in sroot.find('m:sheetData', NS).findall('m:row', NS):
            for c in row.findall('m:c', NS):
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('m:v', NS)
                f = c.find('m:f', NS)
                val = None
                if f is not None:
                    val = '=' + (f.text or '')
                elif v is not None:
                    val = v.text
                    if t == 's':
                        val = shared[int(val)]
                    elif t == 'b':
                        val = val == '1'
                    elif t == 'inlineStr':
                        is_ = c.find('m:is', NS)
                        val = ''.join(tt.text or '' for tt in is_.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
                print(f"  {ref}: {val!r}")
        print()
